name: paragraph_1
label: Paragraph 1 (Definition & Foundation)
default: Moqui is an open-source Java and Groovy framework for building custom ERP and commerce applications, built around a Universal Data Model and Universal Service Library with reusable business artifacts. It provides one foundation for business automation applications, multi-instance SaaS, and ready-made apps, with built-in REST APIs.

name: paragraph_2
label: Paragraph 2 (HotWax Systems Track Record)
default: HotWax Systems has built on the open-source Moqui ecosystem since its earliest days, with 100+ engineers delivering enterprise solutions across complex operations. With a proven foundation, we focus on what makes your operation different, helping you launch in months with full ownership of your code, data, and roadmap.
